title: D3-3a N02: Minimum Effective Water Permeability and Cleaning Trigger for Aged Membranes
question_prompt:
D3-3a N02: Minimum Effective Water Permeability and Cleaning Trigger for Aged Membranes

An SWRO train at fixed pressure shows irreversible compaction/fouling, represented by normalized A. Vary A_comp only. Find the minimum A that still meets 10,000 m³/d and the minimum recommended A preserving 2% margin, 10,200 m³/d. Prove each with adjacent 0.01×10⁻¹² m/s/Pa points and identify the CIP or replacement-assessment trigger.

Fixed case (except decision variable) | Constraints and criteria
Parameter | Value | Unit | Note | Level | Criterion | Evidence
Feed flow | 0.3 | m³/s | Fixed unless decision variable | Basic | Product ≥10,000 m³/d | 0.01×10⁻¹²
TDS | 38 | g/L | Fixed baseline | Recommended margin | Product ≥10,200 m³/d | 0.01×10⁻¹²
TSS | 0.03 | g/L | Pretreatment design | Membrane A (×10⁻¹²) | Membrane water permeability A | Vary this only
Temperature | 22 | °C | Fixed | Objective | Minimize required A
Active membrane area | 13500 | m² | Fixed
A_comp | 4.2e-12 | m/s/Pa | Fixed baseline | Required deliverables
B_comp | 3.5e-08 | m/s | Fixed | 1. Establish a coarse safe/fail bracket.
P1 outlet pressure | 70.3 | bar(a) | Fixed | 2. Prove the adjacent basic pass/fail boundary.
P1 efficiency | 0.82 | - | Fixed baseline | 3. Switch to the stricter recommended margin and prove its adjacent boundary.
PX efficiency | 0.96 | - | Fixed baseline | 4. Report product, recovery, P1/P2, SEC and daily energy at the recommendation.
P2 efficiency | 0.82 | - | Fixed | 5. Give an actionable operating, alarm, maintenance or expansion decision.
Energy recovery | pressure_exchanger | - | Fixed

Scope: use full-plant simulate_swro_system and hold every input fixed except Membrane water permeability A. The recommended margin is benchmark-specific, not a universal industry standard.
